application_credentials.description:
Follow the [instructions]({more_info_url}) for [OAuth consent screen]({oauth_consent_url}) to give Home Assistant access to your Google Health data. You also need to create Application Credentials linked to your account:
1. Go to [Credentials]({oauth_creds_url}) and select **Create Credentials**.
1. From the drop-down list select **OAuth client ID**.
1. Select **Web application** for the Application Type.
